info.title: Job Search API (Indeed, LinkedIn, Reed, ATS Boards)
info.description: Job postings from Indeed, LinkedIn, Reed, Seek, Wellfound, Welcome to the Jungle and the career pages of companies on Greenhouse, Workday and other applicant tracking systems, in one API.

RapidAPIKey.name: x-rapidapi-key
RapidAPIKey.description: Your RapidAPI subscription key from rapidapi.com

post.description: Indeed job postings by keyword and location in 62 countries: title, employer, location, pay, full description, job type, remote flag and apply link. Up to 20 jobs per request, as JSON.

queries.title: Job titles or keywords
queries.description: What to search for: job titles, skills or company names. Each entry is searched in each location. Indeed's operators work: title:(data analyst) matches the job title only, company:Siemens one employer, quotes an exact phrase.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, regions or postcodes in the chosen country, for example Austin, TX or Manchester or 10115 Berlin. Leave empty to search the whole country.

countryCode.title: Country
countryCode.description: The Indeed country site to search. Pay is read in each country's own currency. Links bring their own country.

maxResults.title: Maximum jobs per search
maxResults.description: Rows to save for each search (each combination of keyword, location and job type) and each search link. A request returns 20 rows at most.

postedWithinDays.title: Only jobs listed in the last … days
postedWithinDays.description: Keeps jobs Indeed listed within this many days. Any number works, and it works together with the job type and remote filters.

jobTypes.title: Job types
jobTypes.description: Keeps jobs Indeed marks with this type. Several types are searched one after the other, and a job that carries two of them is saved once.

remote.title: Workplace
remote.description: Keeps jobs Indeed marks as remote or as hybrid work.

titleOnly.title: Match the job title only
titleOnly.description: Indeed also matches words in the description, which brings jobs with unrelated titles. With this on, every search word must be in the job title.

distance.title: Distance around the location
distance.description: Miles in the United States and the United Kingdom, kilometres elsewhere. Without a value the distance is 25.

sort.title: Order
sort.description: Newest first is the order for date limits and monitoring. Most relevant first is Indeed's own ranking for the first 1,000 jobs of a search.

links.title: Indeed links
links.description: Search links from any Indeed country site (the words, place, age, distance, job type and remote filter of the link are used) and links of single jobs, which are looked up directly.

201.description: JSON array of results (up to 20 items per request).

post.description: Public LinkedIn job postings by keyword and location, with full descriptions and company data. Up to 3 jobs per request, as JSON.

keywords.title: Job keywords
keywords.description: Plain-text source search. Strict matching requires every word in the title or full description; disable it for source-defined query syntax.

jobUrls.title: Direct job URLs or IDs
jobUrls.description: Public /jobs/view/ URLs or numeric IDs. Overrides search; keyword and recency filters do not apply.

maxResults.title: Maximum matching jobs
maxResults.description: Maximum jobs collected in this snapshot, before only-new filtering. A request returns 20 rows at most.

maxPages.title: Maximum search pages
maxPages.description: Scan at most this many result pages even when fewer jobs match. A page has ten jobs, so 100 pages reach LinkedIn's 1,000-result limit.

timeRange.title: Posted within
timeRange.description: Source recency filter, also checked against available calendar dates. Not an exact-hour timestamp guarantee.

sortBy.title: Source ordering
sortBy.description: Ordering requested from LinkedIn; the source may rank or recommend results.

strictKeywords.title: Require all keyword words
strictKeywords.description: Reject unrelated source recommendations: every keyword word must occur in the title or description, ignoring case.

workTypes.title: Workplace filters
workTypes.description: Pass these filters to LinkedIn. Leave empty for any.

jobTypes.title: Employment filters
jobTypes.description: Pass these filters to LinkedIn. Leave empty for any.

experienceLevels.title: Experience filters
experienceLevels.description: Pass these filters to LinkedIn. Leave empty for any.

201.description: JSON array of results (up to 3 items per request).

post.description: Job postings from Reed.co.uk by keyword: title, company, location, salary, work type, posting date, badges and link. Up to 20 jobs per request, as JSON.

keyword.title: Keyword / job title
keyword.description: Job title, skill or keyword to search on Reed.co.uk, e.g. 'python developer'.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional UK city, county or region, e.g. 'London', 'Manchester' or 'Surrey'.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of Reed jobs to return. A request returns 20 rows at most.

201.description: JSON array of results (up to 20 items per request).

post.description: Job postings from Wellfound, the startup job board. Up to 20 jobs per request, as JSON.

locations.title: Wellfound locations
locations.description: Cities, countries or regions represented by Wellfound location pages, for example Berlin, London or United States.

keywords.title: Job keywords
keywords.description: Match roles, skills, startup names or text in the public job description. Leave empty to include all jobs in each location.

remoteOnly.title: Remote-capable jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Return only listings Wellfound marks as remote or remote-capable.

minimumSalary.title: Minimum published salary
minimumSalary.description: Minimum lower bound of the published salary range. Currency is reported separately per job.

includeJobsWithoutSalary.title: Include jobs without salary
includeJobsWithoutSalary.description: Keep listings where the employer did not publish a compensation range.

maxResultsPerLocation.title: Maximum jobs per location
maxResultsPerLocation.description: Maximum unique matching jobs saved for each Wellfound location. A request returns 20 rows at most.

maxPagesPerLocation.title: Maximum pages per location
maxPagesPerLocation.description: Safety cap for Wellfound location-page pagination.

201.description: JSON array of results (up to 20 items per request).

post.description: Welcome to the Jungle job postings by keyword, country and city: title, company, location, remote policy, salary, contract, description and apply link. Up to 13 jobs per request, as JSON.

queries.title: Job search queries
queries.description: Roles, skills, employers or keywords to search in public WTTJ jobs.

locale.title: Output market
locale.description: Language used for WTTJ URLs and localized company, sector and contract labels.

countryCodes.title: Countries
countryCodes.description: Optional two-letter country codes, for example FR, GB, US, DE or ES.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Optional exact city names, for example Paris, London, Berlin or Prague.

languages.title: Job languages
languages.description: Optional language codes for the job posting content, for example en or fr.

searchTitleOnly.title: Search titles only
searchTitleOnly.description: Match each query only against job titles instead of all searchable job fields.

postedWithinDays.title: Maximum posting age
postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs published within this many days. Use 0 for any posting age.

includeDetails.title: Fetch job-page details
includeDetails.description: Fetch each public job page for the full description, application URL, validity date and street-level location fields.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Maximum jobs per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum unique job rows saved for each search query. A request returns 20 rows at most.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum search pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Safety cap for source pagination, especially when using posting-age filters.

201.description: JSON array of results (up to 13 items per request).

post.description: Returns live job postings from company career pages on five applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee) in one dataset: title, company, department, location, employment type, remote flag, posting date and job link. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

sources.title: ATS sources
sources.description: Which Applicant Tracking Systems to pull jobs from.

greenhouseCompanies.title: Greenhouse companies
greenhouseCompanies.description: Greenhouse board tokens (company slugs). Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

leverCompanies.title: Lever companies
leverCompanies.description: Lever company slugs. Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

ashbyCompanies.title: Ashby companies
ashbyCompanies.description: Ashby job-board names. Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

smartrecruitersCompanies.title: SmartRecruiters companies
smartrecruitersCompanies.description: SmartRecruiters company identifiers (case-sensitive). Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

recruiteeCompanies.title: Recruitee companies
recruiteeCompanies.description: Recruitee company subdomains. Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

keywords.title: Keyword filter
keywords.description: Only keep jobs whose title contains any of these keywords (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all.

location.title: Location filter
location.description: Only keep jobs whose location contains this text (e.g. 'Berlin', 'New York', 'United States').

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Include the full job description text (larger output).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to return. A request returns 20 rows at most.
